steps.do: Connect the wallet to the app (it is listed as MetaMask) and close any first-visit prompt in the way. If the app shows the wallet as connected already, do nothing.

notes.text: When the user rejects a transaction, the page currently shows no message (the alert stays empty) and the button just goes back to "Bridge". A test should check the button and the balance rather than look for an error message.

Picking a destination changes the URL to /bridge/<chain>?fromChainId=…&fromCurrency=…&toCurrency=…, and it is kept on reload, so a test can open a route directly. The recipient is changed by clicking the address button above the To amount, which opens the Wallet "To" dialog.
Pressing Bridge asks the wallet to switch to Ethereum mainnet (chain 0x1) and then sends one eth_sendTransaction carrying the ETH as its value. No token approval comes first when the source is ETH.
Amounts that are too small, such as 0.0000001 ETH, also show "Quote unavailable". No minimum amount is given anywhere on the page.
The swap history list rows show only amounts and status; the recipient is only visible on the entry's detail page.
The wallet shows calldata undecoded, so a signed check must match the recipient address as lowercase hex without 0x.
Max fills in the whole ETH balance, and the app has no quote for the 100 ETH the test wallet holds ("Quote unavailable"), so a test can't go on from Max.

The transaction was mined
The page shows a “Swap transaction” page for the order with status In progress, amount 0.01 ETH from Ethereum to USDC on Base, and the recipient is the same address as the sender 0xc5F3a3...5Bd6F

steps.claim: Swap history lists an entry of 0.01 ETH to a USDC amount with status In progress
